declaration.preface:
Kraftwares (India) Pvt. Ltd. is committed to integrating ethical, responsible, and sustainable practices across its supply chain operations. The Company recognizes that procurement and supplier relationships play a critical role in promoting environmental stewardship, ethical business conduct, fair labor practices, and respect for human rights.

The Ethical and Sustainable Supply Chain Policy establishes the framework for managing supplier relationships and procurement activities in a responsible manner. Through this policy, Kraftwares (India) Pvt. Ltd. aims to ensure that all goods and services are sourced from partners who operate in compliance with applicable laws, uphold ethical standards, and support environmental and social sustainability throughout the supply chain.
declaration.declaration: Kraftwares (India) Pvt. Ltd. is committed to conducting business with integrity by ensuring our procurement practices align with sustainability principles. We aim to minimize environmental impact, promote fair labor standards, and protect human rights. By partnering with suppliers who share these values, we will foster sustainable and ethical practices across our supply chain. We will continuously evaluate and improve our procurement processes to align with evolving sustainability trends, regulations, and best practices, with 2022 as the baseline year for tracking progress and performance.
declaration.scope: This Policy is applicable to following sites and all of its employees, workers, sub-contractors and other stakeholders:

Focus Area: Encourage suppliers to adopt environmentally responsible practices aimed at reducing energy consumption, emissions, water use, and waste generation.
Support the integration of sustainable materials, resource efficiency, and pollution prevention practices within the supply chain.

Promote responsible labour practices within the supply chain by encouraging suppliers to comply with applicable labour laws and internationally recognized human rights principles promoted by the International Labour Organization.
Ensure suppliers maintain safe and healthy working conditions and prohibit child labour, forced labour, discrimination, and harassment across their operations.
Strengthen supplier accountability by integrating social responsibility criteria into supplier evaluation and engagement processes.
Support suppliers in improving their sustainability performance through knowledge sharing, training programs, and awareness initiatives.
Promote collaboration with suppliers to enhance responsible sourcing practices and long-term sustainability across the supply chain.
Promote an inclusive and diverse supplier base by providing fair and equal opportunities for suppliers of different sizes, backgrounds, and ownership structures.
Ensure supplier selection processes are transparent, objective, and based on fair evaluation criteria.

responsibilities.duty: Accountable for overseeing the implementation of the sustainable sourcing policy, conducting supplier evaluations, and ensuring alignment with the company’s sustainability goals.
Responsible for selecting suppliers who meet the company’s environmental and labor standards, facilitating supplier training, and ensuring ongoing compliance with sustainability criteria.
Responsible for monitoring supplier adherence to labor and human rights standards, identifying non-compliance issues, and ensuring corrective actions are taken as needed.

policy.monitoring:
Kraftwares (India) Pvt. Ltd. monitors its ethical and sustainable supply chain performance across key areas, including responsible sourcing, supplier environmental and social compliance, occupational health and safety practices, and adherence to applicable regulatory requirements. Defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are tracked through internal procurement and supplier management processes to evaluate progress against sustainability objectives.

Performance is reviewed on a quarterly basis and consolidated for senior management review to support responsible sourcing and informed decision-making. Annual assessments are conducted to identify achievements, gaps, and areas for improvement, and relevant outcomes are communicated to appropriate stakeholders to promote transparency and accountability. All monitoring and reporting activities are aligned with applicable laws, recognized sustainability frameworks, and industry best practices to ensure consistency, accuracy, and credibility.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Sustainability Manager will conduct an annual review of this policy to evaluate its effectiveness in achieving sustainable sourcing goals. This will include assessing supplier performance, monitoring responsible sourcing practices, and addressing any non-compliance. The review will incorporate supplier audits, feedback from the procurement team, and the results of training programs. Based on these findings, updates will be made to ensure alignment with ESG standards and maintain the company’s commitment to sustainable procurement.
